source: Federal Reserve Board, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), table F3_5_s (amounts outstanding) and F3_5_t_tu (transactions, not seasonally adjusted), one line per holding sector
note: The share of each owner is of everything outstanding. Net bought is the Federal Reserve's quarterly net purchases; price and other changes is the change in holdings minus what was bought, which is mostly price moves. The Fed carries Treasury, agency, municipal and corporate bond totals at face value and most holders at market value, which is part of its published gap. Everything outstanding includes bonds issued abroad that Americans own, shown under the owners. The world ledger leaves them out of the American figure: it counts every bond where it was issued.
